_comment: Authored Dive links for the off-screen water links (water.py, world simulation spec, walker graph). Each row joins two open-water tiles that Dive and emerge connect, both directions, so the off-screen simulation can cross between the two water bodies. The on-screen walker never uses water. Sootopolis's only way out is diving through Underwater_SootopolisCity, whose warp leads to Underwater_Route126 (45, 65); emerging there surfaces on Route126 at the same tile.
